profile.headline: Lead Principal Software Engineer at Oracle Health

positions.title: Sr Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I am a lead engineer on Amazon Translate. Building on top of several AWS technologies, I help design, implement, and launch new features to enable customers to translate text both synchronously and asynchronously.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I worked on multiple teams, from Promotions Platform (Amazon Retail), to Payments (AWS), and AWS AI/ML (Amazon Lex, Amazon Comprehend, Amazon Translate). In AWS Payments, I worked on rearchitecting, developing, and scaling both new and legacy services. I lead the development of several features to allow AWS customers to pay for their invoices in the currency of their choice, whether they were using a credit card, bank account, or invoicing. In AWS AI/ML, I designed, implemented, and launched major features of both Amazon Comprehend and Amazon Translate.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the Foreign Exchange team in Payments for Amazon retail websites. We enabled customers to pay for their orders in the currency of their choice, avoiding the confusion of paying in an unfamiliar currency.

patents.title: Machine translation with adapted neural networks
patents.description: A translation system receives examples of translations between a first language and a second language. In response to receiving a request to translate a source text from the first language to the second language, the system ranks the examples based on the example's applicability to one or more portions of the source text. The system performs additional training of a neural network that was pre-trained to translate from the first language to the second language, where the additional training is based on one or more top-ranking examples. The system translates the source text to the second language using the additionally trained neural network.
